usage: agentbreeder status [-h] [--state-dir STATE_DIR] [--json] [--no-verify]
                           [--stack DIR] [--environment ENVIRONMENT]
                           id

positional arguments:
  id

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --state-dir STATE_DIR
  --json
  --no-verify           Skip principal re-resolution
  --stack DIR           Use the operator config and state that `services up`
                        wrote for DIR
  --environment ENVIRONMENT
                        With --stack: the stack environment
